name: Sanhur
registryAssessment: The Egyptian General Survey Authority (ESA) is evidenced as the national survey and cadastral-map custodian, and an official/first-party report documents a Fayoum GIS unit for inventorying state property across centres and villages. ESA's public route offers map products and paid/request-based digital map services, but no current anonymous Sanhur parcel layer, schema, or geometry API was established; registryFound remains null.

officialSources.role: Egyptian General Survey Authority official overview
officialSources.observation: Describes ESA's historical role in topographic/cadastral mapping and property records and lists map and surveying services.
States that digital GIS maps can be requested by location, scale, layers, format, and projection through a quotation/purchase workflow; no anonymous feature service is exposed in the page.
Confirms ESA map production, spatial data, state-property inventory, and citizen/entity surveying services; it does not publish Sanhur parcel geometry.

Reports a Fayoum GIS unit for inventorying and digitizing state property across centres and villages and mentions work in the Senورس centre; this is evidence of a local custodian/workflow, not an open cadastral API.
Shows Fayoum map coverage and map scales, including village maps, but is a map index/document rather than parcel-vector data.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe anonymous native parcel ID plus full polygon response was obtained from the official public routes; no GeoJSON retained.
